paragraphs.text: DSH Web UI telemetry strip for current-session stats, token usage, and context occupancy
# Session telemetry

A small DSH Web UI plugin that renders a detailed telemetry card below the
composer, in `conversatio

n.composer.dock`. It follows the active conversation
and summarises:

- **Current session** — whole-session turn and step counts, model/tool time,
first-token latency, an

d decode speed.
- **Token usage** — cumulative uncached input, cache read, cache write, output,
tota

l, and cache-hit rate.
- **Context used** — a ring gauge for context occupancy, used/capacity figure

s,
and a system/tools/messages composition bar.

When the plugin is active it replaces the shipped `activity` and `usage` pills
and hides the shipped

context-occupancy ring, so the same figures are not shown
twice.
## Data sources

The card uses the composer dock's standard `useProjection` and `useSession`
props:
| Projection | Source | Used for |
| `sessionStats` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-stats` (inserted by this bundle) | turns, steps, LLM/to

ol time, decode speed |
| `tokenUsage` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` | input, cache, output token

s |
| `contextPressure` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` | context occupancy and capacity |
| `conte
xtBreakdown` | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-token-meter` | system/tools/messages composition |

No new projection, tool, prompt section, model input, network request, or
session event is added. Th
e plugin writes no DOM outside its own React tree.
## Presentation

- Uses only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens for surfaces, text, and borders.
- Localised through the Cl

ient locale service in English and Simplified
Chinese; metadata is exported in `locale/en.json` and

`locale/zh.json`.
- Bars and rings are inline SVG/CSS, not images or canvas.
- Accent colors use blu

e, red, yellow, green, and orange.
- The card shows detailed readings: model/tool time, first-token

latency, output
speed, uncached input, cache read/write, output, total, cache-hit rate, context
occu

pancy, and the system/tools/messages composition.
- The outer border is omitted; sections are separa

ted by divider lines.
- The context ring sits at the right of its section, and all three section bar

s
share one baseline.
- The card fills the available composer width (up to
`--dsh-composer-card-max-

width`) and stacks its three sections below 560px.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` for the runni

tacks its three sections below 560px.
- Respects `prefers-reduced-motion` for the running indicator.
## Install

Requirements: DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x with the Web UI. No build step or runtime
dependencies.
Open **Settings → Plugins → Add** and use one of:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Refresh the page after installation. The bundle patch inserts the
`sessionStats` host projection and
the Client plugin row.
## Limits

- The card follows the composer's current Session. Without a Session it renders
nothing.
- Context o

ccupancy appears only after the provider reports usage and the route
reports a context window.
- `co

ntextBreakdown` is the token meter's heuristic composition; it is an
approximation and does not sum

to provider-billed pressure.
- The context figure clamps the ring at 100% while the numeric numerato

r can
exceed the capacity.
- Hiding the shipped context ring uses a narrowly scoped DOM/CSS compatib

ility
rule; a future DSH composer redesign may require updating that selector.
